summary: Ferrari N.V. furnished a Form 6-K with an exhibit press release dated November 3, 2026, reporting preliminary unaudited Q3 and nine-month 2026 results. Net revenues were €1,896 million, up 7% (10% constant currency); EBIT €563 million at a 29.7% margin, up 12%; net profit €431 million; diluted EPS €2.44; EBITDA €753 million at a 39.7% margin; industrial free cash flow €567 million, up 43%. Q3 deliveries were 3,368 units amid planned model change-over, and full-year 2026 guidance was raised again. No transactional event; not a special situation.
